source_clauses.verbatim: I need a clamp that fixes a monitor arm to the edge of my desk.
Desk edges here are between 18 and 40 mm thick.
Once it is tight it must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
I want to be able to take it off and move it to another desk without any tools.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I need a clamp that fixes a monitor arm to the edge of my desk.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The clamp attaches the monitor arm to the edge of the desk.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Desk edges here are between 18 and 40 mm thick.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The clamp fits desk edges with thickness in the range 18 to 40 mm.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Once it is tight it must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
requirements.observable_verbatim: After tightening, the clamp does not slip or rotate when the weight of the arm is applied.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I want to be able to take it off and move it to another desk without any tools.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The clamp can be removed and moved to another desk without using tools.

scenarios.name: Installation on desk edge
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the clamp and the monitor arm it fixes. Outside: the desk edge and the environment.
scenarios.environment: The clamp is placed on a desk edge.

scenarios.name: Operation under load
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the clamp and the attached monitor arm. Outside: the desk and the environment.
scenarios.environment: The clamp is tightened and the monitor arm is loaded by its weight.

scenarios.name: Removal and relocation
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the clamp. Outside: the desk edge, the new desk, and the environment.
scenarios.environment: The clamp is removed from one desk and moved to another.

freedoms.decision: The mechanism by which the clamp attaches to the desk edge.
freedoms.why_free: The request does not specify the attachment method, only that it must fix the monitor arm to the desk edge.
The request does not specify any material.

freedoms.decision: The specific tool-free mechanism (e.g., lever, knob, cam).
freedoms.why_free: The request states the requirement to be tool-free but does not specify how.

ambiguities.statement: The weight of the arm is not specified in numerical terms.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: When the monitor arm model is selected or a load rating is provided.

ambiguities.statement: The meaning of 'tight' is not defined.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: When a specific tightening torque or clamping force is defined.

ambiguities.statement: The desk edge conditions (material, surface finish, geometry) are not specified.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: When the desk type is identified.

assumptions.statement: The monitor arm has a standard mounting interface.
assumptions.why: The request refers to 'a monitor arm' without defining its attachment interface.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the monitor arm uses a non-standard interface.

assumptions.statement: The desk edge is horizontal and has a uniform thickness within the stated range.
assumptions.why: The request says desk edges are between 18 and 40 mm thick, implying a range of typical edge thicknesses.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the desk edge is not horizontal or has varying thickness.
